description: Login Screen polish + Voice Workspace enhancement + NotFound brand alignment. Three visual-only component changes: (1) the login screen already has two-column JSX structure — FEAT-001 adds the CSS for it; this FEAT adds password visibility toggle and entrance animation class to the auth-card; (2) Voice Workspace gets a ripple ring animation class, cleaner status label indicators, and waveform bar visualizer placeholder; (3) NotFound page gets brand-aligned styling to match the rest of the app instead of a generic slate/blue look. Depends on FEAT-001 for animation tokens. These three are batched into one FEAT because they are all small component-level changes that share the same CSS file additions.
steps: Step 1 — LocalLoginScreen.tsx: add password visibility toggle. Import Eye, EyeOff from lucide-react. Add state: const [showPassword, setShowPassword] = useState(false). Wrap the password Input in a relative div with class 'password-wrap'. Change Input type to {showPassword ? 'text' : 'password'}. Add a toggle button inside the wrapper positioned absolutely at the right edge. Keep all existing form logic unchanged. Add .password-wrap and .password-toggle CSS classes to index.css: .password-wrap { position:relative; } .password-toggle { position:absolute; right:10px; top:50%; transform:translateY(-50%); border:0; background:transparent; color:#9b91a3; padding:4px; cursor:pointer; display:grid; place-items:center; }

Step 2 — LocalLoginScreen.tsx: add entrance animation to the auth-card. Add class 'auth-card-enter' to the <div className='auth-card'> element (append it: className='auth-card auth-card-enter'). Add to index.css: .auth-card-enter { animation:fadeInUp .4s cubic-bezier(.23,1,.32,1) both; animation-delay:.1s; }. The fadeInUp keyframe was added in FEAT-001.

Step 3 — Add ripple animation variant to the .voice-ring.recording rule in index.css. Replace the existing .voice-ring.recording { animation:pulse 1.6s infinite; ... } with an enhanced version that uses recordingPulse (defined in FEAT-001): .voice-ring.recording { animation:recordingPulse 1.8s ease-in-out infinite; border-color:#bb8c9b; box-shadow:0 0 0 0 rgba(187,140,155,0); }. Add a ripple pseudo-element via a new class added in the JSX: Add className='voice-ring-ripple' wrapper div around voice-ring in VoiceWorkspace.tsx, and define: .voice-ring-ripple { position:relative; display:grid; place-items:center; } .voice-ring-ripple::before { content:''; position:absolute; inset:-14px; border-radius:50%; border:1.5px solid rgba(187,140,155,.35); animation:recordingPulse 1.8s ease-in-out infinite .3s; pointer-events:none; } — ONLY show ::before when recording; gate it with a data attribute: add data-recording={phase === 'recording'} to the .voice-ring-ripple div, then .voice-ring-ripple[data-recording='false']::before { display:none; }

Step 4 — Add a waveform visualizer placeholder below the voice-ring in VoiceWorkspace.tsx. After the existing …status…, add:
. Add CSS to index.css: .voice-waveform { display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:3px; height:20px; margin-top:6px; } .voice-waveform span { width:3px; border-radius:2px; background:#c4afd0; animation:signalBounce 1s ease-in-out infinite; } .voice-waveform span:nth-child(1) { height:6px; animation-delay:0s; } .voice-waveform span:nth-child(2) { height:14px; animation-delay:.1s; } .voice-waveform span:nth-child(3) { height:18px; animation-delay:.2s; } .voice-waveform span:nth-child(4) { height:10px; animation-delay:.3s; } .voice-waveform span:nth-child(5) { height:6px; animation-delay:.4s; } .voice-waveform:not([data-active='true']) span { animation-play-state:paused; opacity:.3; height:4px!important; }. Add data-active={phase === 'recording' || phase === 'speaking'} to the .voice-waveform div.

Step 5 — NotFound page (client/src/pages/NotFound.tsx): replace the generic slate/blue/red styling with brand-aligned classes. Change the outer div from min-h-screen w-full flex items-center justify-center bg-gradient-to-br from-slate-50 to-slate-100 to className='auth-screen' (reuses the brand radial gradient background from FEAT-001). Change the Card from w-full max-w-lg mx-4 shadow-lg border-0 bg-white/80 backdrop-blur-sm to className='auth-card' style={{textAlign:'center'}}. Remove CardContent's pt-8 pb-8 text-center classes (auth-card already centers). Change the pulsing red AlertCircle wrapper to use brand purple: replace the absolute bg-red-100 div with className='notfound-pulse' and change text-red-500 to style={{color:'var(--purple-600)'}}. Change h1 from text-4xl font-bold text-slate-900 to the Playfair serif style: className='notfound-code'. Change h2 from text-xl font-semibold text-slate-700 to className='notfound-title'. Change the Go Home button from bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-700 to className='primary-button'. Add these classes to index.css: .notfound-code { font:500 64px/1 'Playfair Display',serif; color:var(--purple-700); margin:0 0 8px; } .notfound-title { font:500 20px 'Playfair Display',serif; color:#5c5167; margin:0 0 16px; } .notfound-pulse { position:absolute; inset:0; border-radius:50%; background:var(--purple-100); animation:pulse 2s infinite; }
